title: Reuse accessible plan and evidence references in a complete handoff

rubric.text: Uses the existing approved plan, repository instructions, exact worktree/base state, and current validation record by reference after confirming that this worker can retrieve them and that they describe the assigned revision.

Keeps objective, exact owned files, allowed and forbidden actions, acceptance criteria, expected result and returned evidence, focused check, blocker path, and no-further-delegation boundary decision-complete; includes task-specific scope or permission differences explicitly instead of assuming the references cover them.

If assigning an independent fresh review, gives it the approved source, fixed base and candidate head, applicable standard, and required verdict and coverage in its brief; supporting pointers do not rely on inherited conversation for these essentials.
Avoids copying the full plan or evidence into the brief and retains lead inspection of the owner's commit and verification evidence before acceptance.
Reviews the proposed handoff without dispatching an agent, running commands, or changing files.
